boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on the Fenway, Park Drive, Boylston Street, Huntington Avenue, Evans Way, Brookline Avenue, and Jersey Street corridors near Emmanuel College.

cards.title: Back Bay Fens — Olmsted landscape
cards.subtitle: Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Park Drive and follow the paths past water, memorials, fields, and garden areas; use the park page to orient a self-guided walk.
cards.short_summary: A large historic park landscape beside the Park Drive corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston identifies Back Bay Fens at 100 Park Drive and lists community gardens, the Kelleher Rose Garden, memorials, ball fields, and birdlife among its features.
cards.access_notes: Public park; check City of Boston notices for temporary maintenance or event impacts.

cards.title: James P. Kelleher Rose Garden — roses and fountain
cards.subtitle: Park Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the stone-dust paths and benches for a close look at the rose beds, fountain, statues, and arbors at this Park Drive garden.
cards.short_summary: A formal rose garden set within the Back Bay Fens.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Boston places the garden at 70 Park Drive and documents roughly 200 rose varieties, nearly 1,500 roses, benches, cherubs, and a fountain.
cards.source_title: Improvements to James P. Kelleher Rose Garden | Boston.gov
cards.access_notes: Located in the Back Bay Fens; stay on public paths and respect any posted garden protections.

cards.title: Fenway Victory Gardens — public garden paths
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Boylston Street and visit the public herb, medicinal, or pollinator areas during the day; individual plots are cared for by members.
cards.short_summary: Historic community gardens with public spaces in the Fens.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fenway Garden Society says the gardens are at 1200 Boylston Street, open dawn to dusk, have no admission fee, and include public spaces.
cards.source_title: Get In Touch — Fenway Victory Gardens
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk; public areas are available during the gardening season and are locked overnight and in winter.

cards.title: Museum of Fine Arts, Boston — campus museum access
cards.subtitle: Huntington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit through the Huntington Avenue entrance; Emmanuel states that its students receive free MFA access, so bring the required student identification.
cards.short_summary: A major art museum a short walk along Huntington Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel College describes the MFA as 0.5 miles from campus and free for Emmanuel students; the MFA lists its main entrance at 465 Huntington Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Emmanuel identifies free student access; confirm any required ID or reservation details with the MFA before visiting.

cards.title: Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum — courtyard galleries
cards.subtitle: Evans Way corridor
cards.notes: Reserve a timed entry before heading to Evans Way, then allow time for the historic galleries and courtyard rather than treating it as a quick stop.
cards.short_summary: An art museum on Evans Way with timed admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gardner Museum lists its address as 25 Evans Way and advises that advance ticketing is recommended because entry times can sell out.
cards.source_title: Directions and Parking | Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum
cards.access_notes: Advance tickets are recommended; the museum lists Green Line access via Longwood Medical Area.

cards.title: Evans Way Park — short park connector
cards.subtitle: Evans Way corridor
cards.notes: Use this small Fens-side stop as a walking connector between Emmanuel’s side of The Fenway and the Gardner area, keeping to public park paths.
cards.short_summary: A named City park access point on Evans Way.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Parks and Recreation lists Evans Way at 1 Evans Way among the Back Bay Fens locations and facilities.
cards.source_title: Playgrounds And Parks In Boston | Boston.gov
cards.access_notes: Part of the Back Bay Fens park system; observe posted conditions and maintenance notices.

cards.title: Time Out Market Boston — multi-kitchen meal stop
cards.subtitle: Park Drive and Brookline Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Park Drive entrance when you want several food-counter options in one building; check the market’s current kitchen listings before choosing.
cards.short_summary: A food market at the Park Drive–Brookline Avenue corner.
cards.evidence_claim: Time Out Market Boston identifies its location as 401 Park Drive, at the corner of Park Drive and Brookline Avenue, and describes a selection of eateries.
cards.access_notes: Individual kitchen hours can vary; review the market’s current information before going.

cards.title: Fenway Park — ballpark history and tours
cards.subtitle: Jersey Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the official ballpark calendar or tour information before walking over; the venue offers both Red Sox games and scheduled walking tours.
cards.short_summary: The Red Sox ballpark on the Jersey Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Red Sox list Fenway Park at 4 Jersey Street and state that individual and group walking tours are available every day.
cards.source_title: Fenway Park: Home of the Red Sox | Boston Red Sox
cards.access_notes: Games and tours require advance planning; consult the official Red Sox site for current availability.

cards.title: The Huntington Theatre — live performance venue
cards.subtitle: Huntington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Look up the current season and content advisories before reserving a performance; use the Huntington Avenue venue page for current route details.
cards.short_summary: A professional theatre venue on Huntington Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Huntington identifies its theatre at 264 Huntington Avenue and describes it as a venue for theatre productions and education programs.
cards.access_notes: Performance dates, ticket availability, and advisories vary by production; verify before purchase.

cards.title: Jordan Hall — conservatory concert setting
cards.subtitle: Huntington Avenue and Gainsborough Street corridor
cards.notes: Check New England Conservatory’s concert schedule, then use the Gainsborough Street entrance; arrive with time for venue entry procedures.
cards.short_summary: A New England Conservatory performance space near Huntington Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: New England Conservatory states that concerts are held in the Jordan Hall building, whose street entrance is at 30 Gainsborough Street.
cards.access_notes: NEC lists the Jordan Hall building’s academic-year hours as 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; concert access depends on the event.
